External service marks

The icons in this folder are service marks from Simple Icons
(https://simpleicons.org/), dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
The names and logos remain trademarks of their respective owners.

Each icon is included so a diagram can identify that service. These marks are
not MIT, and they are not infrasketch artwork. Do not present a mark as a
claim that its owner made, sponsors, or endorses this package.

Source control and DevOps: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jenkins, CircleCI,
Travis CI, Argo CD.

CDN, edge, and DNS: Cloudflare, Akamai, Fastly, Bunny.net.

Containers and Kubernetes: Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, Red Hat OpenShift, Helm.

Observability: Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Splunk.

Security and identity: Okta, Auth0, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet.

Messaging: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS.

Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Cassandra,
MariaDB, SQLite, Neo4j, Couchbase, CouchDB, InfluxDB, CockroachDB, ClickHouse,
ScyllaDB, OpenSearch, DuckDB, TimescaleDB, ArangoDB, SingleStore.

Data and analytics: Snowflake, Databricks.

SaaS: Atlassian Jira.
